title: Shopping for Dinner
text:
Anna has a shopping list. She needs milk, eggs, bread and two apples. She writes the list on a small piece of paper.

At the shop, Anna finds the milk first. Then she buys the eggs and the bread. The apples are very red and cheap, so she buys six.

questions.text: How many apples does Anna need?
What does Anna buy first at the shop?
Why is the shopping list useful for Anna?
options: It helps her remember what to buy
It tells her when the shop opens
It is a present for a friend

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's shopping trip?
options: She forgot most items on her list
She got everything on her list
She bought things that were not on her list
She went to the shop twice

vocabulary.definition: a set of written names or things that you need or want
a place where you buy things

paragraph_translations: У Анни є список покупок. Їй потрібні молоко, яйця, хліб і два яблука. Вона пише список на маленькому папірці.
У магазині Анна спочатку знаходить молоко. Потім вона купує яйця і хліб. Яблука дуже червоні й дешеві, тому вона купує шість.
